Privacy

This storefront page does not include account creation or payment processing. If the update form is used, the submitted email address is used for TGB Global product updates and related storefront communication.

Purchases are completed on Gumroad. Gumroad may process buyer information, payment information, receipts, downloads, tax records, fraud prevention signals, and support messages according to its own policies and checkout flow.

The page includes first-party event hooks for storefront improvement. Event delivery is disabled unless a deployment owner configures an analytics endpoint. When enabled, events are limited to interaction names, page paths, referrers, and timestamps.

For product-specific support or data questions, use the seller contact options available through Gumroad or the contact path at TGB Global.
